description: This file defines the WatchlistRepository class which implements data access methods for managing watchlist entries, including creation, deletion, retrieval, and audit logging, using Prisma ORM.

classes.name: WatchlistRepository
classes.description: Repository class for managing watchlist entries with methods for CRUD operations, checks, and audits.

methods.name: createEntry
methods.description: Creates a new watchlist entry and logs the creation in the audit table within a transaction.

methods.name: createEntryIfNotExists
methods.description: Checks if a watchlist entry exists; if not, creates it.

methods.name: checkExists
methods.description: Checks if a watchlist entry exists based on type, value, organizationId, and isGlobal.

methods.name: findAllEntriesWithLatestAudit
methods.description: Retrieves watchlist entries with the latest audit info, supporting search and filters.

methods.name: findEntryWithAuditAndReports
methods.description: Fetches a specific watchlist entry with its audit history and associated booking reports.

methods.name: findEntriesByIds
methods.description: Retrieves multiple watchlist entries by their IDs.

methods.name: deleteEntry
methods.description: Deletes a watchlist entry and logs the deletion in the audit table.

methods.name: bulkDeleteEntries
methods.description: Deletes multiple watchlist entries in a transaction, logging each deletion.

methods.name: createEntryFromReport
methods.description: Creates a watchlist entry from a report, ensuring it does not already exist.

methods.name: findOrgAndGlobalEntries
methods.description: Retrieves watchlist entries for an organization and global entries, with search and filters.
